scene.title: Title-screen start prompt
scene.summary: The fixed start-menu label loaded with the title program.

rows.linguistic_and_cultural_notes: Fixed-address interface record: 6 packed bytes. The natural field expands the meaning; the patch-safe field retains the verified slot form. Reconstructed Japanese is conservative editorial normalization; any kana left unreconstructed remains deliberately unresolved rather than being silently assigned kanji.
rows.problems_with_current_english: Technical abbreviation: current slot text 'START' represents 'Start from the beginning' in 6 packed bytes. Natural meaning is expanded in the final field.
